description: This file defines a Java class 'ConcurrencyFailureExceptionMapper' which implements exception mapping for concurrency failures in a REST API context. It converts specific Spring concurrency exceptions into HTTP 409 Conflict responses with a standardized error response format.

classes.name: ConcurrencyFailureExceptionMapper
classes.description: A JAX-RS exception mapper that handles 'ConcurrencyFailureException' and maps it to a HTTP 409 Conflict response, with additional logging and specific handling for optimistic locking exceptions.

methods.name: toResponse
methods.description: Converts a ConcurrencyFailureException to a HTTP Response, logging the exception and returning an error response indicating a lock conflict.

methods.name: errorCode
methods.description: Returns a specific application error code (4009) associated with concurrency failure errors.
